claim_boundary: C020 registers JANUS Tear as a falsification-led algorithmic research line. The universal all-residual quotient is terminally false; the policy-selected solver, no-cache lower-bound bridge, and exact formula-caching route remain open. No entry resolves P versus NP.

hypotheses.title: Universal Continuation-Complete JANUS Tear Quotient Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every CNF F of encoding length L, all residual formulas obtained from partial assignments admit a polynomial-time JANUS Tear signature with only poly(L) possible values such that equal signatures preserve satisfiability under every common future continuation and preserve enough information for SAT witness recovery.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The complete residual search space could be folded into a polynomial quotient; if the quotient and transitions were constructible with polynomial total work, SAT would be in P and therefore P=NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_UNIVERSAL_ROUTE: test whether one continuation-complete polynomial quotient can replace exponential residual search.
hypotheses.next_gate: Attack the class count on explicit linear-size formula families and require pairwise continuation distinguishability rather than syntactic difference.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H128 abstracts the missing global quotient into a universal residual equivalence relation and strengthens it with continuation and witness-recovery completeness.
falsification_conditions: A linear-size CNF family producing exponentially many residuals that are pairwise distinguishable by future continuations.
A proof that decision-only signatures hide SAT inside extraction rather than yielding an algorithm.
A witness-recovery requirement forcing more than polynomially many classes.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: This is the strong all-state formulation, not the weaker claim that one algorithm may visit only selected states.

hypotheses.title: Policy-Selected JANUS Tear Solver Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists one explicit deterministic algorithm that, on every CNF F of length L, selects a polynomial number of residual states and polynomially verifiable Tears, spends polynomial total extraction, transition, proof, normalization and witness-recovery work, and returns either a satisfying assignment or a sound polynomially checkable UNSAT artifact.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The algorithm decides SAT in polynomial time, so P=NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: replace the false all-state quotient by one fully charged selected-state policy whose correctness and polynomial bound are both explicit.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix concrete policies, hide their preferred invariants by equivalent encodings, and seek an infinite family forcing superpolynomial charged work.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H129 drops the impossible requirement to classify every residual and requires only the states actually selected by one explicit total-work algorithm.
falsification_conditions: Every proposed concrete policy has an explicit infinite family requiring superpolynomial charged work.
Tear extraction or normalization invokes SAT, formula equivalence, or another uncharged NP-hard oracle.
Witness recovery or proof verification exceeds polynomial work.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Failure to find a counterexample is not evidence. Proving H129 requires the complete algorithm and a polynomial worst-case theorem.

hypotheses.title: Policy-0T Resolution Simulation and MAJ3 Lifting Route
hypotheses.statement: For the fully specified no-cache Policy-0T, every terminating UNSAT execution of charged work W on N variables can be transformed into an ordinary Resolution, hence Res(⊕), refutation of size O(W) and depth O(N). Combined with MAJ3 lifting of expander-Tseitin formulas, this yields an exponential lower bound for Policy-0T.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Policy-0T is rigorously excluded as a polynomial-time universal SAT policy on an explicit infinite family, isolating the exact additional strength required from future JANUS Tear policies.
hypotheses.proof_role: ALGORITHMIC_LOWER_BOUND_ROUTE: certify a solver-to-proof translation and import a width-to-depth lifting theorem against one exact no-cache policy.
hypotheses.next_gate: Implement stable clause provenance, unit reasons, branch combination and an independent proof verifier; then prove the size and depth recurrences represented by the verifier.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H130 fixes one concrete no-cache descendant, replaces abstract quotient arguments by a proof-emitting execution, and connects it to the MAJ3 Res(⊕) lifting theorem.
falsification_conditions: A Policy-0T inference cannot be simulated in Resolution with polynomial overhead.
Unit simplification or local learned clauses require uncharged semantic weakening.
The emitted proof depth can exceed O(N).
The selected lifted Tseitin family lacks the required base resolution width.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Even if proved, H130 excludes only Policy-0T. It does not lower-bound unrestricted SAT algorithms or prove P!=NP.

hypotheses.title: Policy-0A Formula-Caching Classification and Lower-Bound Bridge
hypotheses.statement: The exact residual memoization and local learned-clause mechanism of Policy-0A can be formalized as a specific formula-caching proof calculus for which either a depth-controlled simulation into Res(⊕) or a direct lifting/lower-bound theorem applies on MAJ3-lifted expander-Tseitin formulas.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The caching version of the concrete JANUS Tear policy receives a rigorous superpolynomial lower bound, or its extra proof-theoretic strength is precisely identified.
hypotheses.proof_role: BARRIER_BREAKER: replace the invalid assumption that residual caching is free Resolution DAG sharing by an explicit calculus and a valid comparison or direct lower bound.
hypotheses.next_gate: Emit an FC/CC-style proof object for every cache hit and learned residual, then determine whether the resulting calculus is simulated by Res(⊕) or needs a new lifting theorem.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H131 separates exact formula caching from ordinary proof-DAG reuse and makes the missing proof-system classification itself the next theorem.
falsification_conditions: Policy-0A cannot be represented by a polynomially checkable caching calculus.
The exact calculus has polynomial proofs on the proposed lifted family.
No depth-preserving simulation or direct lower-bound method applies to the calculus.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H131 is a proof-complexity interface problem, not evidence that caching makes SAT polynomial.
